name: QuietRoom
title: QuietRoom: Spatial nature sounds for focus and rest
desc: Arrange rain, forest, water and fire sounds around you in 3D. 36 bundled nature sounds, offline playback, sleep timer and optional head tracking on iPhone.
hero_body: QuietRoom places nature sounds around you: rain on the window to your left, a stream ahead, a fire just behind. Put on headphones, start listening, and shape the room until it feels right.
cta_soon: Coming soon on the App Store

features: Drag each sound around a 3D listener: left or right, in front or behind, above or below. Or set direction, elevation and distance precisely. Wide backgrounds stay steady around you.
Rain, thunder, birds, streams, waves, wind, insects, footsteps and fire. Recordings vary naturally, so the room never feels like a short loop. Preview any sound, Pro included, before you add it.
Thunder, birdsong, drips and footsteps arrive now and then. Choose Rare, Normal or Frequent for each one. Footsteps can also walk continuously.
Start from Rainy study, Forest camp or Seaside cabin, or begin with a blank room. Changes save automatically; rename, duplicate or replace saved rooms anytime.
With compatible headphones, spatial sounds stay put as you turn your head. Regular headphones still give fixed spatial sound.
No account, no ads, no analytics. Sounds are bundled, so listening, editing and saving work without a connection. A sleep timer fades out gently.
pricing_title: Free to start. One purchase for everything.

privacy: QuietRoom is published by hiimobapps. It has no accounts, advertising, tracking or third-party analytics, and there is no QuietRoom server. The app does not collect personal data.

Sounds are bundled with the app. Your rooms, settings and the latest valid backup are stored only in the app’s local container on your iPhone. There is no cloud sync. Device backups you make through Apple may include this app data according to your own settings.
Deleting the app removes its rooms from your device.

When you turn on head tracking with compatible headphones, orientation is processed locally by Apple’s audio system. QuietRoom does not record, store or upload head-pose or motion history. Declining Motion access does not prevent ordinary playback.

Purchases and restores are handled by Apple through StoreKit under Apple’s terms. QuietRoom receives only the verified status of your purchase and never sees payment-card details. Restoring on a new installation needs an internet connection.
QuietRoom does not request microphone, location, contacts, photos, health or advertising-tracking access.
QuietRoom does not knowingly collect information from anyone, including children.
If you email us, we use your message only to reply, and you can ask us to delete it at any time. Contact: {email}.
If this policy changes, the updated version will be posted on this page with a new date. If translations differ, the English version prevails.

faq: How do I restore my Pro purchase?
Open Settings (the ··· button) or the Pro page and tap Restore purchases. Use the same Apple Account you bought with. A new installation needs an internet connection the first time.
Is Pro a subscription?
No. QuietRoom Pro is a one-time, non-consumable purchase. Refunds follow Apple’s policies.
How do I make my own room?
Tap the room title to open Rooms. Choose Add new room to start blank, or Save current room to keep your current mix. Edits save automatically. Free includes one room of your own; Pro allows twenty.
How do I move a sound up, down or behind me?

Drag its icon around the head; you can move it above, below or behind you. For exact values, tap the sound and set Direction, Elevation and Distance. Drag the head itself to look at the room from another angle; that does not change what you hear.
Head tracking says it is unavailable.

Head tracking needs headphones that support it, spatial audio enabled for the current output, and Motion access for QuietRoom. It starts while a room is playing. Regular headphones still give fixed spatial sound, and speakers give basic playback.
How long does a sound preview last?

As long as you like. A preview plays until you tap Stop, close the sound library or leave the app. Any sound can be previewed, including Pro sounds. A playing room lowers its volume during the preview.
Thunder or birds come too rarely, or too often.
Tap the sound in your room and choose Rare, Normal or Frequent under How often. Footsteps also offer occasional steps or a continuous walk.
Does QuietRoom play in the background?
Yes. Playback continues on the lock screen and in the background, with lock-screen controls. Turn on Mix with other audio in Settings to play alongside other apps.
How does the sleep timer work?
Choose 15, 30, 60 or 120 minutes. The room fades out over the last ten seconds and stops. Pausing manually turns the timer off.
Where are my rooms stored? How do I delete them?
Only on your iPhone. Delete a room from Rooms → ··· → Delete, or delete the app to remove everything.
